prepare: Sit or lie down somewhere safe, away from water. Never practise while driving. If you feel unwell, stop and return to normal breathing.
learn_breathing: Breathe fully in, allowing your belly and chest to expand comfortably. Let the breath out softly, without pushing it out. Follow a pace that feels comfortable. You can pause or stop at any time.
learn_retention: After the final gentle exhale, pause your breathing only until you need to breathe again. You do not need to empty your lungs completely. There is no time to beat. Tingling is not a goal. If sensations become uncomfortable, return to normal breathing.
round_start: Let's begin. Full breath in, then let it go gently.
next_round: When you're comfortable, begin the next round. Breathe in, then let it go.
last_breaths: Last few breaths. After your final gentle exhale, pause only while comfortable.
hold_breath: Pause your breathing. Breathe in whenever you need to.
retention_relax: If it helps, notice the support beneath your body. Soften your jaw, shoulders and hands. Breathe in whenever you need to.
retention_notice: You might notice your hands or fingertips. There is no sensation to find or create. Let your attention rest, and breathe in whenever you need to.
recovery_breath: Take a comfortable, full breath in.
recovery_hold: Hold gently, without straining. You can release early.
release: Let go. Return to easy, natural breathing.
round_complete: Rest here for a few natural breaths. There is no rush.
session_complete: Your session is complete. Keep breathing naturally. Take your time before getting up.
gentle_intro: We'll breathe gently for five minutes, with no breath holds. Breathe in comfortably, then let the out breath be a little longer. Keep your breaths light and easy. Follow your own rhythm if this pace doesn't feel comfortable.
gentle_reminder: Let the breath stay light. Soften your shoulders. There is no need to take a bigger breath.
preview: Breathe fully in. Let it go gently. Soften your shoulders and hands. Follow your own comfortable pace.
